name: Capitalonline Data Service Co., Ltd.
summary: Capitalonline Data Service Co., Ltd. provides cloud hosts and bare metal products in China, the Americas, Europe, and the Asia Pacific. The company provides cloud services, communication network services, IDC services, and general computing and intelligent computing services. It offers global dedicated internet services; premium internet routing; BGP IP transit; mirror hosting; and ChinaEdge, an internet content provider services; and internet content provider services.
